answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before it can earn: creating a thousand fake identities means funding a thousand stakes, so a Sybil swarm costs real capital instead of free keystrokes. Honest agents earn the stake back with interest from completed work, while proven cheaters forfeit theirs. Like a dune that shifts grain by grain yet a knoll stays put under wind, the cost curve stays steep for attackers and flat for real participants, because fakes must pay the same price as the genuine.
